note: NOTE: v0.2.7. A Path is an open skill tree a Hero can train. Any Hero can train any path; a skill needs the previous skill in its chain (rank 1+) plus materials. Levels are only a pacing guide for recipe cost: green ~ L5, blue ~ L10, orange ~ L20 (out of scope).  v0.2.8: Magician Path is live (Magic Bolt, Mana Shield, Fire Bolt, Thorn Volley, Chain Spark).

rows.name: Warrior Path
rows.description: Melee: Power Strike at the root, Nature and Elemental branches below.

rows.name: Magician Path
rows.description: Ranged and MP-hungry: Magic Bolt at the root, a ward, and Fire, Thorn and Spark branches.
